display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig DURA／实增益首筛独立评分恢复
description: Recover independent CPU scoring only from the original completed, immutable source screening predictions.
authorization: Current user LoRa and WiSig fusion objective and small screening before any complete target release.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32, separate CPU scorer

data.dataset: IEEE DataPort multi-receiver LoRa and WiSig/ManySig Main split
data.version: lora_full_packets_v1; WiSig registered R17/WiSig Main source cache
data.representation: LoRa complex 8192 at 1 MS/s -> original W24. WiSig complex 256 -> original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
data.contract_ref: LoRa parent frozen source contract.json; WiSig 20261019-phase1-reception-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m6-r02/cache/complete.json
data.physical_ids_ref: 192 blind held-out V packets per dataset at one fixed source receiver; LoRa excludes original 300 source panel; WiSig precomputed 1800 Full V may contain already exposed benchmark IDs. Freeze selected IDs in predictions.npz.
data.label_map_ref: Original frozen E104 (10) and WiSig Main seed 2026092701 (6); independent scorer only.
data.validation_ref: Reuse registered validates-once source handles and fixed physical panels.
data.leo_config_ref: Only clean and the previously registered source Full practical_low_urban. Targets and other five views are outside this release.

permissions.claim_scope: Scorer only. Verify both source V matrices are frozen and match the original prescribed physical IDs before reading either source label vector. No target reads, no fit and no predictions.

checkpoint.initialization: No new model loads or updates. Both original r01 weights and predictions remain archived.

sources.role: Both complete LoRa and WiSig prediction matrices and frozen parameters.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned historical releases, runtime contracts, strict weight loads and fixed-panel comparator check.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No weight crosses dataset boundaries. LoRa exact R69 weight is unavailable under this source contract; native R17 is the current matched DURA family comparator in the screen. A like-for-like two-stage LoRa DURA adaptation is still needed before final acceptance.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Per dataset, on the fixed RX and 192 matched pairs, the candidate must net at least 8 extra correct in low urban versus every control, and each 95% paired bootstrap lower bound must exceed zero. Clean correct must meet or exceed maximum control. Two views and all four paths frozen before independent scorer. Proceed to separately preregistered official evaluation only for a passing dataset.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.stop_rule: Stop on incorrect original failure state, missing/malformed both old blind matrices, or source-contract drift.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: runs/20261128-phase1-lora-wisig-gain-dura-screen-s2026113047-r02/scores.json after both datasets freeze; CPU truth-last, no target.

rows.method: Independent score of the already frozen four paths
rows.seed_notes: Both existing predictions retain their registered frozen reader seeds; the scorer adds no model/augmentation seed.

notes: Both source predictions and WiSig 8000 updates completed. The r01 CPU scorer failed because legacy LoRa import bound an incompatible WiSig namespace, before completing the score. This technical retry uses exactly the old matrices, sample IDs, labels and promotion rule. The original root and logs remain immutable.
